notes.title: Patch Update
notes.content: [p]Thank you to everyone who has played and supported the game so far. I’ve been overwhelmed by the positive reception and helpful feedback. [/p][p][/p][p]This update focuses on balance adjustments based on community feedback, especially around the Valve Puzzle. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced sanity loss from the Valve Puzzle to make it more forgiving.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced sanity loss from the radio task as it was also excessive.[/p][/*][/list]
